**Estate:** 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), clay/flint. ~62,000 bottles/yr; 2024: 48,000 after May hail destroyed ~20% of western plots.

**Certification:** Organic since 2019. Biodynamic conversion began 2023; earliest certification 2026.

**Sales:** Export 41%, mainly Belgium/Japan. Japanese importer requires sulphites <60 mg/L.

**Failures:** 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; batch sold in bulk, €11,000 loss. Fixed: pre-harvest calibration, second probe on tank 4. 2023: 900 mislabelled bottles recalled. Fixed: two signatures on label proofs.

**Rules:** No irrigation on western plots (2021 trial lowered acidity). Harvest dates from sugar/acidity over three consecutive mornings. Tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

**Open:** Lighter bottles (2025 proposal; importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison). Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years old, yields down 30% in five years.
